correctness.rationale: When every cyclic rotation of a factor with >=2 markers occurs, list its cyclic zero gaps a_i>=1. Rotating to expose each preceding partial gap and the next full source gap, nondecreasing source gaps force a_{i-1}<=a_i all around, hence all equal a. The boundary rotation 0^a(10^a)^{r-1}1 requires >=r consecutive equal-a source gaps; conversely r such gaps plus the following gap >=a generate all cyclic shifts. Thus L(n)=2+Σ_{a+1|n, 2<=n/(a+1)<=m_a}1; m_a=a yields L(t!)>=t+1. The all-zero and one-marker baseline classes exist from unbounded gaps.
